name: A Pilgrim's Bad Poetry
summary: Pilgrim Quill has an ode to the Crimson Abbot, and means to recite it at the next Night of Flames.

stages.journal: Pilgrim Quill has composed an ode to Father Renathyr and wants a rhyme for monastery.
stages.hint: Help Quill with the ode before the next Night of Flames.

stages.journal: Quill's ode is as good as it will get.
Quill read his ode as it was, and the monastery did not clap.
